new.title: Let components join a shared README row without taking its help links
new.body:
Let components join a shared README row without taking its help links

When several components.d entries share a `name`, the README generator
merges them into one product row. The Getting Help row then takes the
links of whichever synced entry sorts first by URL, so adding a second
source repo to an existing product can silently repoint every skill in
that row to the new repo's issues, contributing and security pages.

Add an optional `links.primary` field. A component with
`links.primary: false` still adds its skills to the shared row but only
supplies the row's help links when no primary component shares the name.
Help rows now carry a priority (synced, then `primary: false`, then
manual) and the lowest priority wins, which keeps the existing rule that
synced links replace manual em dashes.

Output is unchanged for the current components.d set.

new.body:
## NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super

[NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super](https://ollama.com/library/nemotron-3.5-super) is a vision-language model for coding, reasoning, tool use, and document understanding. It pairs a 120B-parameter hybrid Mamba-2/Transformer mixture-of-experts backbone (12B active per token) with a C-RADIO vision encoder, and supports tool calling, an on/off thinking mode, and context up to 1M tokens.

```
ollama run nemotron-3.5-super
```

A compact sibling, [Nemotron 3.5 Bolt](https://ollama.com/library/nemotron-3.5-bolt), distills Super down to 74B parameters (9B active) tuned to fit a 24 GB NVIDIA GPU for everyday agentic tasks, with speculative decoding via its included drafter.

## What's Changed
* Decision models are now available on cloud — use `clef:cloud` and `clef-flash:cloud` to run decision models through ollama.com cloud without pulling them locally
* Continuing an OpenAI-compatible Responses conversation that includes custom tool calls no longer fails with an error
* Clearer error messages when cloud access fails: sign-in problems, payment issues in the desktop app, and upstream access errors from the ChatGPT gateway now explain what went wrong
* Updated llama.cpp (adding Nemotron 3.5 support) and MLX

## New Contributors
* @willietran made their first contribution in https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/18986

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/compare/v0.40.4...v0.40.5

new.title: v0.40.4
new.body:
## Decision models in the CLI
Decision models can now be used directly from the terminal with `ollama run` — ask yes/no questions, classify text into labels, or score against a rubric:
`ollama run nimble --ask "Is a refund being requested?" < ticket.txt`

 ## What's Changed
  * Kev decision models are now supported by the MLX runner on Apple silicon
  * `ollama launch` can now be used with usage credits without upgrading to a paid plan
  * `ollama launch codex` now includes locally installed Ollama models in its model picker. Use `/model` within the Codex CLI to swap models.
  * Improved inference performance by reusing verified manifests and already loaded models
  * Added support for multimodal embeddings through llama-server
  * Fixed loading multimodal embedding models with small context windows
  * Improved Gemma 4 prefill performance on NVIDIA GPUs with the MLX runner
  * MLX runner now clips long Laya states instead of rejecting them
  * Improved speculative decoding reliability in the MLX runner, including recurrent state handling after rollback
   * Updated llama.cpp with native decision model support
  * Updated README and documentation with clearer privacy and cloud-services wording

  
  **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/compare/v0.40.3...v0.40.4

## What's changed

- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL` to choose the model the client-side auto mode classifier uses; it does not change the model for server-side auto mode

- Added a notice to `/design-sync` and `/design-login` that standalone Claude Design (claude.ai/design) closes by December 14, 2026
- Fixed a "Prompt is too long" error when stopping a turn while the conversation was being compacted
- Fixed requests failing with "diagnostics: Extra inputs are not permitted" after switching to Vertex or Bedrock mid-session
- Fixed the Read tool loading an image file of any size, or a pipe or device named like an image, entirely into memory; image sources over 128 MB are now refused
- Fixed `/autocompact` and `/effort` saving to the wrong model when a gateway names Opus 4 or 4.1 with a prefix, such as `anthropic/claude-opus-4-1`
- Fixed a prompt cache miss when a tool added mid-session was loaded again through ToolSearch or after compaction
- Fixed `claude plugin` and other subcommands sometimes exiting before a queued settings or config write finished, which could lose the change or leave a `.tmp` file behind
- Fixed plugin marketplaces re-cloning on every refresh, and newly installed git plugins showing version "unknown", when git defaults to the reftable ref format
- Fixed the PowerShell tool not finding commands in a plugin's `bin/` folder, and reporting an error when a search that finds nothing (rg, grep, findstr, git grep) is piped into `Select-Object` or another formatting cmdlet
- Fixed Claude in the desktop app pointing you to claude.ai settings or `/mcp` to authorize or reconnect an MCP server where that option isn't available
- Fixed artifact publishes sometimes failing when Claude sent an empty list of edits, and Claude retrying an artifact update the wrong way after a newer version of the artifact turned it away

- Fixed rows in the agents view staying blank after moving down a long list or folding a section
- Fixed `claude remote-control --help` not printing its usage and exiting when not signed in
- Fixed `/design consent` and `/design revoke` suggesting `/design-login` when they fail in a cloud session, where it isn't available; the message now points to claude.ai/design/settings
- Fixed MCP servers showing no tools, or every tool call failing, when the server negotiates protocol version 2026-07-28 but omits `resultType`, `ttlMs` or `cacheScope`
- Fixed prompt suggestions spending usage credits on models your plan pays for only with credits: they are now skipped after a reply billed to credits
- Fixed URLs written in backticks being clickable only on their first row when they wrap; the whole URL is now one link in terminals that support hyperlinks
- Fixed `claude plugin details <name>@builtin` suggesting `claude plugin list`, which never shows built-in plugins, when the plugin isn't found; it now points to `/plugin`

- Windows: Fixed every file write being refused or asked about for projects on exFAT or FAT32 drives, including in sessions started with `--plugin-dir`

## What's changed

- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_USAGE_LIMIT_WAIT_MS` so unattended retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) ends a request at a usage limit that resets too far away instead of waiting
- Added OpenTelemetry tracing guidance to the `claude-api` skill, including setting up trace destinations with the `ant` CLI
- Added the `%` motion to vim mode: jump to the matching bracket, alone or with d/c/y
- Added `rows` to a mod's `Input`: a text field of several lines in the terminal, where Enter submits and Shift+Enter or a backslash before Enter starts a new line
- Added `classifier_verdict` and `permission_mode` to OpenTelemetry `tool_decision` events, so auto mode classifier decisions can be told apart from permission rules
- Added `classifier_category` to OpenTelemetry `tool_decision` events, naming the built-in rule a classifier block matched, when `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1`
- Fixed quitting removing a worktree made by a `WorktreeCreate` hook without asking when it may hold unpushed commits
- Fixed the `fable` (and `best`) model alias erroring on the Anthropic API when the newest Fable model is not available to your organization: Claude Code now retries once on the previous Fable model
- Fixed a misleading "Please run /login" error when a full disk keeps the login from being refreshed; the error now names the disk and says to delete files
- Fixed Grep and Glob reporting no matches when the search program failed unexpectedly before returning any results; they now return an error saying the search failed
- Fixed workflow agents sometimes skipping their step, and the run still reporting success, after reading the harness note that their task text carries no user authority
- Fixed artifact updates being refused where a PreToolUse hook covers Edit or Write; Claude now edits the file and then republishes instead of changing it in the publish call
- Fixed skills and commands with very many or very long argument names stalling for seconds when invoked; only the first 64 names, each up to 64 characters, are now filled in
- Fixed skills, commands and hooks using very large amounts of memory when their arguments fill many placeholders
- Fixed stray characters such as `>0q` covering the folder trust prompt, and `>4m` before the shell prompt at exit, in terminals built on VTE older than 0.53 such as MATE Terminal on RHEL 8

- Added support for rewriting a workflow agent's `prompt` and `model` in the `agent.spawn` mod hook, which could only refuse workflow agents before

## What's changed

## 29.9.1

For a full list of pull requests and changes in this release, refer to the relevant GitHub milestones:

- [docker/cli, 29.9.1 milestone](https://github.com/docker/cli/issues?q=is%3Aclosed+milestone%3A29.9.1)
- [moby/moby, 29.9.1 milestone](https://github.com/moby/moby/issues?q=is%3Aclosed+milestone%3A29.9.1)

### Security

The containerd update to v2.4.2 includes fixes for the following security vulnerabilities:

- [CVE-2026-95839](https://github.com/containerd/containerd/security/advisories/GHSA-vwhp-8p66-mq4f): Pulling or importing an image through containerd's transfer service could crash containerd if a child descriptor contained the `io.containerd.manifest.subject` annotation and a malformed digest.
- [GHSA-8647-2jxj-p2rc](https://github.com/containerd/containerd/security/advisories/GHSA-8647-2jxj-p2rc): An untrusted registry returning a crafted `Content-Length` header could crash containerd when parallel layer fetching was enabled with `concurrent_layer_fetch_buffer`.
- [GHSA-hc94-p972-ch66](https://github.com/containerd/containerd/security/advisories/GHSA-hc94-p972-ch66): Pulling a crafted image or pulling from a malicious registry could exhaust host disk space because containerd did not limit incoming layer data to the declared size before validation.

### Bug fixes and enhancements

- Fix `--link-local-ip` accepting addresses that are not link-local (169.254.0.0/16 or fe80::/10) when creating a container or connecting it to a network, which  made the container fail to start. [moby/moby#53923](https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53923)
- Fix `COPY --from` in the classic builder failing for files not owned by root when userns-remap is enabled. [moby/moby#53859](https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53859)
- Fix `docker ps -s` and container listing with sizes failing entirely when the size of one container cannot be computed. [moby/moby#53921](https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53921)
- Fix `docker save` leaving image layers on disk after the image is removed, when the image contains the same layer more than once (graph-driver image store). [moby/moby#53927](https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53927)
- Fix a daemon panic when using the `fluentd` log driver with a TLS address that cannot be connected to and `fluentd-async` enabled. [moby/moby#53922](https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53922)
- Fix image digest resolution failing when a registry mirror succeeds but a subsequent registry lookup fails. [moby/moby#53933](https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53933)
- Fix plugin privilege lookup reporting success when fetching the plugin fails. [moby/moby#53934](https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53934)

### Packaging updates

- Update containerd (static binaries) to [v2.4.2](https://github.com/containerd/containerd/releases/tag/v2.4.2). [moby/moby#53936](https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53936)

### Networking

- Don't add bridge network interfaces to firewalld's `docker` zone when `iptables` and `ip6tables` are both disabled. [moby/moby#53907](https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53907)
- Fix bridge networks failing to restore on daemon startup when their bridge is bound to a firewalld zone other than `docker`. [moby/moby#53907](https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53907)

### Rootless

- Fix `--domainname` with user namespaces and rootless mode; this requires an OCI runtime supporting the `domainname` field (such as runc >= v1.2.0). [moby/moby#53899](https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53899)
- Update RootlessKit to [v3.3.0](https://github.com/rootless-containers/rootlesskit/releases/tag/v3.3.0). [moby/moby#53942](https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/53942)
